svt_mipi_dsi_dual_monitor_callback Class Reference

Detailed Description

Class that encapsulates MIPI DSI Dual Monitor callback. This class defines DSI Dual Monitor callbacks that can be used by user. User can extend the class, add implementations to one or more of the callback methods.

  function void
 svt_mipi_dsi_dual_monitor_callback::packet_analysis_port_cov
 (  svt_mipi_dsi_dual_monitor dsi_dual_monitor , svt_mipi_dsi_packet pkt  ) 

Callback issued by the component to allow the testbench to collect functional coverage information from a Packet that it just received. This is called by the component immediately before placing the Packet into the output.

dsi_dual_monitor - A reference to the component object issuing this callback. User's callback implementation can use this to access the public data and/or methods of the component.

pkt - A reference to the svt_mipi_dsi_packet descriptor object of interest.

Callback issued by the component just prior executing FSC commands of respective ports.

pkt - [$] An array of svt_mipi_dsi_packet elements, containing FSC commands.

port_idx - indicate the port number/id of respective port.

  function void
 svt_mipi_dsi_dual_monitor_callback::pre_packet_analysis_port_put
 (  svt_mipi_dsi_dual_monitor dsi_dual_monitor , svt_mipi_dsi_packet pkt , ref bit drop  ) 

Callback issued by the component after recognizing a Packet, just prior to placing the Packet in the output.

dsi_dual_monitor - A reference to the component object issuing this callback.

pkt - A reference to the svt_mipi_dsi_packet descriptor object of interest.

drop - A ref argument that, if set by the user's callback implementation, causes the component to discard the svt_mipi_dsi_packet descriptor without further action.
